name: Rushbook
summary: A finance app for a film and video production company: budget, cost and cash for every project
about: A money app for a small production company that tracks the budget and cash of each project, in a cinematic teal-and-orange grade. A slate timeline lays every project out like an edit, and dragging its playhead shows what was spent, billed and in the bank on any day, including the plan ahead. Cost reports, purchase orders, crew days and client billing sit behind it.
how: Drag the orange playhead along the slate timeline (or focus it and use the arrow keys) to see spend, billing and cash on that day.
Switch the burn chart between 90D, 6M and All; the playhead marker follows you.
On Projects, drag a project card to its next stage or use its menu; dropping it on Delivered sends the final invoice.
Open a cost report and edit any estimate: final cost, variance and the totals update as you type.
Raise a purchase order (it warns you if a budget line would go over), approve it and mark it received.
Log crew days, mark client milestones paid, and filter the cash chart by project.
